rows.text:
migration_plan_review approves the reviewed foundation source; all round-2 findings are resolved.
- Independent compiler probe accepts validated recursive read→attach→update, rejects invalid nested payloads (2322) and nested writes (2339); missing-component recovery is now covered on an existing node.
- Reviewed 14/14 store tests, all 11 compiler cases, generated declaration→guard/metadata→store proof, and focused strict validation.
- Full root checkpoint validation is still pending. This does not approve application migration, live persistence cutover or final UI acceptance; native checkpoint outcome remains pending.
